title: Queen and Knight Net
setup: Your knight on f6 and king on h6 surround Black's king in the corner, and its own pawn on h7 fills the last gap.
hint: The knight and king cover the squares around the king. Send the queen along the back rank.
explanation:
## The Idea

The knight and king have boxed the king in: the knight on f6 covers g8, your king on h6 covers g7, and h7 holds Black's own pawn.

{{Qa8#}} checks along the empty back rank from the far corner, and nothing can block.

A knight close to the corner covers the squares a queen cannot reach in one move. With queen, knight and king near a cornered king, look for this net.
